steps.name: check-host-load-and-Ionic-card-action-CSS-before-next-migration
steps.command:
set -eu
echo HEAD;git rev-parse HEAD
echo STATUS;git status --short
echo HOST
uptime
vm_stat | head -12
echo HEAVIEST_PROCESSES
ps -axo pid,ppid,%cpu,rss,command | sort -k3,3nr | head -13 | cut -c 1-180
echo STYLE_TARGETS
grep -R -n -A18 -B3 '\.shelly-ble-action\|\.plug-settings-ionic-action\|\.secondary-action--danger' apps/mobile/src --include='*.css' | head -170
echo DEVICE_NOT_USED
